♡ Booking, Safety & Salon Policies

  • Safety first: For everyone's safety, Gel may decline or reschedule an appointment if you have open wounds, cuts, swelling, infection, significant finger/nail injuries, or if you are feeling unwell.
  • ₱100 down payment: A ₱100 deposit is required to secure your appointment. The deposit is non-refundable.
  • Confirmation: Your booking is not confirmed until the ₱100 deposit has been received and verified by Gel.
  • Late policy: 20 minutes late = ₱100 late fee. 1 hour late = appointment automatically voided/cancelled, and the deposit is forfeited.
  • Last-minute cancellation / no-show: The ₱100 deposit is non-refundable.
  • No companions: No companion is allowed unless previously discussed with Gel.
  • 3-day warranty: Eligible service issues are covered for 3 days. Please contact Gel as soon as possible if there is a problem.
  • Parking: There is no parking area at the studio.

Good to know

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I book an appointment?

Use the booking form above. When you submit it, Viber will open with your appointment details for Gel to review and confirm.

Do you accept nail design requests?

Yes! You can add your inspo or design notes in the booking form. Custom designs may have different pricing depending on the details.

How many slots are available for the October promo?

The October promo is limited to 10 people, so early booking is recommended.

When is my appointment officially confirmed?

Submitting a request does not automatically confirm the appointment. Your slot is confirmed after Gel replies and approves the date and time.
